summary: Elevate your career with our Advanced Excel for Business Intelligence Training Course. Master data analysis and visualization to drive informed decisions.
lede: Excel for business intelligence helps professionals who rely on data turn it into analysis and decision-ready reporting. The training covers advanced formulas, data cleaning, PivotTables, and Power Query workflows for repeatable reports, as well as data modeling and interactive dashboards. Participants also practice scenario analysis and presenting findings through clear visuals.
audienceIntro: This course is ideal for professionals across various sectors who rely on data for decision-making. Whether you're in the public sector, an NGO, or part of a corporate team, this training will enhance your ability to turn raw data into actionable insights.
audience: Operations, supply chain, or procurement teams
modules: Foundations of Excel for Business Intelligence
Power Query for Automation and Efficiency
Excel for Financial and Operational Intelligence
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of Excel, including familiarity with fundamental formulas and functions. Prior experience with data analysis is beneficial but not required.
